attention2.ptxt: If the transaxle assembly is tilted with the torque converter end down, the torque converter can fall off the A/T assembly, which could cause personal injury.
Keep the A/T assembly horizontal or tilted with the torque converter end up throughout the operation.

attention3.ptxt: When A/T assembly is replaced, perform TCM Learning Value Clearance , Neutral Position Calibration and TCM Learning Value Initialization .

s1.ptxt: Shift select lever in N range.
Remove engine undercover and engine under side covers.
Remove exhaust pipe.
Remove front drive shaft assembly.
Remove starting motor.
Remove torque converter locating bolt and torque converter bolts as flows.

s2.ptxt: Lock drive plate by engaging flat-bladed screwdriver or the like (1) with drive plate ring gear.
Remove torque converter locating bolt (1) or torque converter bolts (2) through installation hole of starting motor.
Turn crankshaft 60° by turning crankshaft pulley bolt using wrench.

s1.ptxt: Dismount A/T assembly with engine from vehicle. Refer to Engine Assembly Removal and Installation:K14C .
Disconnect TCM connector (1) and clamps (2).
Disconnect ATF cooler hoses (1).
Remove ATF cooler pipe bolts (2) and remove ATF cooler pipe (3).
Remove bolts (1) and nut (2) fastening engine and A/T assembly, then detach A/T assembly from engine.

attention3.ptxt: When dismounting A/T assembly from engine, move it in parallel with crankshaft and use care so as not to apply excessive force to drive plate and torque converter.

s1.ptxt: Remove battery ground cable (1), if necessary.
Check that torque converter is installed correctly to transaxle.
Tighten bolts and nut fastening engine and A/T assembly to specified torque.
Install ATF cooler pipe (1) and tighten ATF cooler pipe bolts (2) to specified torque.
Connect ATF cooler hoses (3).
Connect TCM connector and clamps.
Positioning battery ground cable to specified angle as shown, tighten battery ground cable bolt (1) to specified torque, if removed.

spec.title: Position range for battery ground cable

s1.ptxt: Remount A/T assembly with engine to vehicle. Refer to Engine Assembly Removal and Installation:K14C .
Tighten torque converter locating bolt and torque converter bolts as follows.

attention3.ptxt: Torque converter locating bolt is used for accurate positioning.
Tighten torque converter locating bolt first so that bolt holes for torque converter and drive plate are positioned properly, and that torque converter bolts are tightened securely.
One torque converter locating bolt and five torque converter bolts are required to secure torque converter and drive plate.

s2.ptxt: Lock drive plate by engaging flat-bladed screwdriver or the like (1) with drive plate gear.
Tighten torque converter locating bolt (1) to specified torque.
Turn crankshaft 60° by turning crankshaft pulley bolt using wrench and tighten torque converter bolt (2) to specified torque.

s1.ptxt: Install starting motor.
Install front drive shaft assembly.
Install exhaust pipe.
Install engine undercover and engine under side covers.
After replacing TCM or A/T assembly with new one, program TCM with calibration data. Refer to Operator’s Manual of SUZUKI ECU Programming System.

attention3.ptxt: Supplied TCM may not be programed depending on the shipping time. When a blank TCM is shipped with a memo indicating that “This ECU does not function without the calibration data”, programing of the TCM with the calibration data is necessary for the activation.

s1.ptxt: Perform TCM Learning Value Clearance , if A/T assembly is replaced.
Perform Neutral Position Calibration , if A/T assembly is replaced.
Perform TCM Learning Value Initialization , if A/T assembly is replaced.
